changelog: Six B-series fixes: ffmpeg's out_time_ms read as microseconds (the bar no longer jumps to 100%); the scratch clear restricted to job-id directories inside the root; the kill report counting processes that exited rather than an estimate; Kill interrupting a Matroska walk at a cluster boundary; job history kept by age instead of dropped past 50; and the shared pass naming tracks it could not produce
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
